scenario: [LSER.16.3.1] / [LSER.14.1]: `pvariance` and `pstdev` are the POPULATION statistics (n), exact over the all-time history on the running-stats backing (SeriesBackendWelfordEwma, [LSER.18.1]). Values 1, 7, 1, 7 then 2, one per pump, each read pre-sample ([LSER.8.6.1]); the guard `s.count >= 4` makes the one read that logs the one over [1, 7, 1, 7]: mean 4, squared deviations 9 + 9 + 9 + 9 = 36, so `pvariance` = 36 / 4 = 9.0 and `pstdev` = 3.0. Every running mean on these inputs (1, 4, 3, 4) is an integer, so Welford's m2 is exactly 36 and the two runtimes must print the same text. Drives libds `welford_ewma.c`'s m2 / w and the Mercury `ds.series` `variance(_, _, 0)`. The `count` guard is 4 and not 2 so that the read covers both pairs.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Reading scope logical:
    dev: String key
    level: Int mutable

series Reading.level (by: dev):
    count, pvariance, pstdev all_time

rule r:
    Reading s where s.count >= 4
->
    log info "pvar {s.pvariance} pstdev {s.pstdev}"
